pages.text: The upgraded purifier: no more fuel burning. It draws $(bold)Chi Energy directly$(), working at $(bold)2x$() the speed and energy cost of a normal purifier.
Crafted around a Akaishi Purifier with Akaishi Ingots, Machine Components, Akaishi Crystals and an Advanced Component.

$(bold)Standalone:$(br)Draws 10 Chi Energy per tick, finishes a purification in ~50 ticks. Outputs match the normal purifier.$(br)$(bold)Purification Matrix shell:$(br)It is the building block of the 3x3x3 "Purification Matrix" - place 26 around a central purifier to form the structure.
